اصطدمن (form VIII)
# اِصْطَدَمْنَ (iṣṭadamna) /isˤ.tˤa.dam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اُصْطُدِمْنَ (uṣṭudimna) /usˤ.tˤu.dim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اِصْطَدِمْنَ (iṣṭadimna) /isˤ.tˤa.dim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
